log_disable_timestamp.description: Whether to disable timestamps in log output

device_name.description: The device name showed in the Spotify UI

device_type.description: The device type showed in the Spotify UI

audio_backend.description: Which audio backend (API) should be used for playback, leave empty for default

audio_backend_runtime_socket.description: The audio backend runtime socket, useful only with pulseaudio as a backend

audio_device.description: Which audio device should be used for playback, leave empty for default

mixer_device.description: Which audio mixer should be used for volume control, leave empty to disable mixer control

mixer_control_name.description: Which control should be used, leave empty for default. Only useful in combination with 'mixer_device'

audio_buffer_time.description: The audio buffer time in microseconds. Available for ALSA backend only, leave empty for default

audio_period_count.description: The number of audio periods to request. Available for ALSA backend only, leave empty for default

audio_output_pipe.description: The path to an existing FIFO for the pipe audio backend

audio_output_pipe_format.description: The format of the audio data written to the pipe

enabled.description: Whether to enable the API server

address.description: Which address to bind for the API server

port.description: Which port to bind for the API server

allow_origin.description: The value for the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header

cert_file.description: File path of the certificate file to use for TLS

key_file.description: File path of the private key file to use for TLS

image_size.description: The preferred size of album cover images served by the API server

voice.description: On-device voice control: 'hey mira' -> ASR -> Spotify search -> play

enabled.description: Enable the voice service (the /voice/trigger endpoint + flow)

wake.description: Also run the always-on 'hey mira' wake-word listener

bin_dir.description: Directory holding the oww_wake + sherpa_asr_server + espeak-ng binaries

lib_dir.description: Directory holding the bundled aarch64 loader + libraries

model_dir.description: Directory holding the wake-word tflite models

mic_device.description: ALSA capture device for the wake-word listener

cascade.description: Enable the phonetic cascade resolver: intent grammar -> routed local index (tracks/artists/playlists/albums) -> IPA phoneme re-rank -> accept/reject threshold -> searchDesktop fallback. Strictly additive (a miss falls through to searchDesktop).

espeak_bin.description: espeak-ng binary name under bin_dir, used for grapheme->IPA (g2p) at sync + query time. aarch64, run via the bundled loader.

espeak_data_dir.description: The espeak --path arg: the dir CONTAINING the espeak-ng-data/ folder (NOT the data folder itself). Empty => <bin_dir>/.. at runtime.

cache_dir.description: Writable dir (persists on /root) for the catalog checkpoint + cached phonetic index. Empty => <model_dir>/../cache.

catalog_sync.description: Run the one-shot Pathfinder catalog sync at startup to build the routed phonetic indexes (liked + playlist names + artists + albums + playlist tracks). No refresh logic yet.

accept_threshold.description: Combined phoneme-distance gate (~0.42). At or below it the local match is accepted; above it the command falls to searchDesktop. 0 => the built-in default.

sherpa_enabled.description: Route ASR through the resident sherpa gigaspeech-Zipformer sidecar. Loads the model once at startup (~20s) and stays resident; strong local-accept, faster per command.

sherpa_bin.description: sherpa ASR sidecar binary name under bin_dir (aarch64, run via the bundled loader).

sherpa_model_dir.description: Directory holding the gigaspeech encoder/decoder/joiner int8 onnx + tokens.txt.

zeroconf_enabled.description: Whether Zeroconf discovery should always be enabled (even when logging in with credentials)

zeroconf_port.description: The port to use for the Zeroconf service (empty for random)

zeroconf_backend.description: The mDNS backend to use for Zeroconf service registration. 'builtin' uses the built-in mDNS responder, 'avahi' uses an existing avahi-daemon via D-Bus

zeroconf_interfaces_to_advertise.description: List of network interfaces that will be advertised through zeroconf (empty to advertise all present interfaces)

spotify_token.description: Authentication with username and access token

persist_credentials.description: Whether credentials from the Zeroconf session should be persisted

bitrate.description: The preferred bitrate for audio playback, default is 160kbps

initial_volume.description: Initial volume in steps (not applied to the mixer device)

ignore_last_volume.description: Whether the last saved volume should be ignored

normalisation_disabled.description: Whether track/album normalisation should be disabled

normalisation_use_album_gain.description: Whether album gain should be used instead of track gain for normalisation

normalisation_pregain.description: The normalisation pregain to apply to track/album normalisation factors

external_volume.description: Whether volume is controlled externally, if true the app will not pre-multiply samples

disable_autoplay.description: Whether autoplay of more songs should be disabled

flac_enabled.description: Whether FLAC files should be preferred over other formats when available
